blocks.x: Uh-huh. J. C., I have -- one of the nice things we have on the tape are some lovely things you said about your mother and how she influenced you. She was the strongest influence in your life.
And I always forgot to ask you what her first name was.
Her first name was Ellen, E-l-l-e-n.
